learning_outcomes.text: Can know the languages used on Earth and the place of the Turkish Language among world languages.
Acquires basic spelling rules and the use of punctuation marks.
Can better use science and knowledge by mastering their mother tongue.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to the content of the Turkish language course and related resources
Definition of language, characteristics, language-culture, language-nation and language-thought relationship. Spoken and written language.
World languages, the place of Turkish among them, and its historical development.
Problems of contemporary Turkish accompanied by current texts. Problems related to the spelling of Turkish words accompanied by compiled texts.
Spelling rules. Punctuation marks. The importance of punctuation marks for language. Application of these marks on example sentences.
Spelling rules accompanied by current texts.
Written expression studies, analyses through examples (Types of composition).
Official correspondence. Petitions, minutes, reports, etc., and practical studies related to these types.
Expression disorders. Applications related to language errors.
Analysis accompanied by current texts: Expression disorders.
